tradeoff_analysis: Adding composite B-tree indexes eliminates full table Seq Scans and in-memory Sort nodes on every standing recomputation and submission feed read, reducing buffer hits from ~120 pages to ~4 pages per query. The trade-off is a small write-amplification overhead (~3 extra B-tree index page updates per submission/attempt write) and ~400 KB of additional index storage per 4,500 submissions.
